reviews.comment: Round-3 re-review: all 4 human blockers confirmed resolved — absolute hook paths, milestones Activity filter, init re-run idempotency, hook events in dashboard. Cross-cutting N26+N27+N28 chain verified end-to-end.

fix.comment: Fixed all 4 blockers: absolute hook paths with stale detection, milestones panel excludes phase markers, N27 merged for log-event+UI, unused TOOL var removed

reviews.comment: Hook scripts block Claude Code on every tool call (~50ms each). Background the log-event call in all 6 scripts (and their templates) so the hook exits immediately. Permission bell/osascript stay synchronous.

fix.comment: Blocker 1 fixed: all 6 lifecycle hook scripts now background log-event with & (fire-and-forget). Bell and osascript in permission script remain synchronous. Templates and deployed files updated.

reviews.comment: Blockers: (1) remove @AGENT_NOTIFY from all 8 role files — AI must have zero notification awareness; (2) lifecycle-agent-idle + lifecycle-permission templates must use insight-flow notify instead of raw osascript (respects notifications.cli flag); (3) README must document the three-tier notification model: hooks, browser, user-authorized agents.extend.

Hook scripts extract SESSION_ID and TOOL for branching but never pass them as --data to log-event. The entire pipeline already supports it: log-event maps payload.tool_name/path to activityEntry.toolName/file, dashboard already renders both. Fix: extract and pass --data in lifecycle-pre-tool.sh and lifecycle-post-tool.sh templates and deployed files.
